page.layout: One column of names, each line set off by rules into groups, with year numbers in the right margin; a note in the left margin; a running head and page number above the column.
page.notes: The first line "Herman Cater," and the right-margin years are printed as marginal notes; the years 1384 to 1390 each stand beside their group. The "C" in "Cater" and "Lewe" is a poor impression; read as Cater and Lewe. The year 1390 is worn and read as 1390. The left-margin note is printed in small type and is read as "solenniter", which is doubtful. The page number "18" is printed in italic at the head.
